text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What an unexpected result. I
guess I
should have expected no less
from the Twinkle
Series.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The stronger my opponents are, the
stronger I'll
become, just as a pearl
grows larger over time!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In other words, today's narrow defeat
has served
to expand my possibilities
even more!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha... thanks. But I've got my sights set
on the
world stage, so I can't allow
myself to be held to
such lenient
standards.
choice_data_list: Your run today wasn't bad, either.
I can take your word for that, right?
I can trust your word on that, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And to even further elevate my pursuit,
we have
to get out there and train! Let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Just sit back, relax, and leave

everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Stand directly by my side so you can
bear witness
to the moment I rewrite
history!
